app.title: VALORANT LIVE TRACKER
idle.title: Waiting for a match
idle.sub: Launch VALORANT and enter agent select or a match — the tracker will fill in automatically.
live.party_tip: Parties are still being detected — colored bars on the left may appear or change.
live.peak_date_tip: Start of the act in which the peak rank was reached (Riot does not store the exact date)
country.private.title: Private profile
country.private.body:
This player hides their tracker.gg profile,
so their country can't be seen.
country.none.title: No country set
country.none.body:
The profile is public, but the player
hasn't chosen a country in it.
country.blocked.title: Search failed: blocked
country.blocked.body:
tracker.gg blocked the request (Cloudflare / rate limit).
Not the player's fault — try again later.
country.badpage.title: Search failed: wrong page
country.badpage.body: tracker.gg returned a page that isn't this player's profile.
country.error.title: Search failed
country.error.body: The lookup itself failed (Edge missing, crashed or timed out).
country.interrupted.title: Search interrupted
country.interrupted.body: The match ended before the search finished.
country.legend.caption: COUNTRY:
country.legend.title: Country column legend
country.legend.body:
Hover an icon in the table to see exactly
why the country is missing for that player.
country.detail.hidden: Nickname was hidden during the match
country.detail.interrupted: Match ended before the search finished
post.title: MATCH RESULTS — {map} [{mode}]
post.legend.green_text: how many times a player on your team killed an enemy
post.legend.red_text: how many times the enemy killed him
pred.empty.title: No active match
pred.empty.sub: The forecast appears as soon as you enter a match.
pred.unsupported.title: No forecast for this mode
pred.unsupported.sub: {mode} has no rounds-based win model, so the outcome can't be predicted. The Players tab still works.
pred.pregame.title: Waiting for both teams
pred.pregame.sub: Enemy players become visible when the match loads. The forecast will be built then.
pred.conf_hint: depends on how many recent matches were found
pred.tile.score_tip: Average final score across all simulated outcomes
pred.tile.stomp_tip: Chance of a lopsided game (the loser takes ≤ 40% of the rounds needed to win)
pred.tile.round_tip: Your chance to win a single round on neutral sides
pred.scores_hint: Chance of overtime / decider: {ot}. Scores are from your team's perspective.
pred.chip_tip: Contribution to your win chance, in percentage points
pred.team_rating_tip: Average player rating: rank + recent form (about 100 points per rank)
reason.rank.pos: Your team has the higher average rank ({a} vs {b}).
reason.rank.neg: The enemy team has the higher average rank ({b} vs {a}).
reason.rank.even: Average ranks are about equal ({a} vs {b}).
reason.form.pos: Your team's recent form is better: their last matches were stronger than the enemy's.
reason.form.neg: The enemy team has been performing better lately.
reason.form.even: Recent form is about equal on both teams.
reason.comp.pos: Your team composition is more balanced. {detail}
reason.comp.neg: The enemy team composition is more balanced. {detail}
reason.star_ally: {name} ({agent}) is the standout on your team and lifts your chances.
reason.star_enemy: {name} ({agent}) is the enemy's strongest player and lowers your chances.
reason.weak_ally: {name} ({agent}) is your team's weak link and lowers your chances.
reason.weak_enemy: {name} ({agent}) is the enemy's weak link, which helps you.
reason.unfamiliar.ally: {name} (your team) rarely plays {agent}, so expect a weaker performance.
reason.unfamiliar.enemy: {name} (enemy) rarely plays {agent}, so expect a weaker performance.
reason.smurf.ally: {name} (your team) looks like a possible smurf ({p}%) and may be stronger than the rank shows.
reason.smurf.enemy: {name} (enemy) looks like a possible smurf ({p}%) and may be stronger than the rank shows.
reason.map_side: On {map} the {side} side wins more often ({p}% of rounds in players' recent matches).
reason.map_side.nodata: Not enough data on {map} to judge side balance; an even split is assumed.
reason.even: The teams are very evenly matched. Expect a close game.
reason.confidence.low: Low confidence: only about {n} recent matches per player were usable.
reason.confidence.medium: Medium confidence: about {n} recent matches per player were usable.
reason.confidence.high: High confidence: about {n} recent matches per player were usable.
players.empty.title: No active match
players.empty.sub: Player analysis appears as soon as you enter a match.
players.click_hint: Click a row to open the player's details.
players.sum.avg_tip: Average strength score of the team (0–100; 50 = average player of this lobby)
players.sum.smurfs_tip: Players (other than you) with a smurf probability of 60% or more
players.breakdown_hint: Right = raises the strength, left = lowers it. Measured against the average of this lobby.
players.no_history: No match history found, so the estimate rests on rank only.
players.form_tip: ACS in the last {n} matches (oldest → newest). Green dot = win, red = loss
players.fact.no_session: Not playing a long session right now.
players.fact.trend: Form over the last 3 matches vs earlier: {p}%.
settings.language.desc: To add a language, put a .json file into the locales folder (see i18n/locales/README.md).
settings.country: Detect player country (unstable, may be slow)
settings.country.desc: Looks up flags via tracker.gg in the background. Can fail or slow the PC down.
settings.party.desc: Shows who is playing together (colored bars next to agents).
settings.depth.desc: More matches = more accurate analysis, but slower loading. Applies from the next match.
settings.peak_date.desc: A small grey month.year next to the peak rank.
settings.on_top.desc: Keeps the tracker above the game window.
